newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco to set new dialing code for mobile phones.
newsitem.headline: Morocco to set new dialing code for mobile phones.

text.p: Morocco, in a move aimed at expanding its domestic mobile phone network to nearly one million numbers, will introduce a new dialing code in October, the official MAP news agency said on Tuesday.
Quoting the state-owned Office National des Postes et Telecommunications (ONPT), MAP said that from October 1, the mobile phone code would change to 01 from 02, which also covers Casablanca.
The change also aims to avoid saturation of Casablanca telecommunication network in future, MAP said.
Casablanca, with four million inhabitants, is Morocco's financial and business centre.
Mobile phone subscribers grew by an average 73 percent between 1994 and 1996, the agency said without giving other details.

In line with the telecommunications liberalisation policy, the ONPT cut rates by up to 25 percent for international calls and reduced some charges for access to GSM mobile phones from July 9, MAP said.
Rate cuts ranged from 11 percent for calls to Portugal to 25 percent to Canada.
With a population of 28 million people, Morocco has on average four telephone lines per 100 people and an estimated 50,000 GSM subscribers, officials said.
